account.title: Account
account.languageDescription: Choose the language used by the interface

voiceSettings.title: Voice
voiceSettings.description: Speech input and read-aloud through an OpenAI-compatible audio service.
voiceSettings.enableDescription: Add microphone and read-aloud controls to messages.
voiceSettings.backendDescription: Use OpenAI, Groq, or a local service such as LocalAI, Speaches, or Kokoro-FastAPI. Leave empty for the server default.
voiceSettings.note: The browser contacts a custom base URL directly, so it must allow CORS. Leave it empty to use the server backend.

preferences.sendByCtrlEnterDescription: When enabled, Ctrl+Enter sends messages instead of Enter. This helps IME users prevent accidental sends.

automation.title: Browser and native applications
automation.description: Review the isolated Chromium runtime and the separately installed CUA Driver.
automation.notDownloaded: Downloads when the Browser panel first opens
automation.grantsDescription: Only targets marked Always allow are saved.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which events can notify you.

desktop.title: Desktop app notifications
desktop.enabled: This desktop app can show notifications
desktop.unsupported: This system does not support desktop notifications.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a brief sound when a chat run ends or needs tool approval.

darkMode.label: Dark theme
darkMode.description: Switch between light and dark themes

interfaceFontSize.label: Interface text size
interfaceFontSize.description: Set text size throughout chats, sessions, settings, and the interface

imagePreviews.label: Image attachment previews
imagePreviews.description: Load image attachments in conversation history

git.title: Git settings
git.description: Set the Git identity used for commits. It is written globally with git config --global.

allowedTools.title: Permitted tools
allowedTools.description: Tools that run without asking for approval

blockedTools.title: Denied tools
blockedTools.description: Tools that are denied without an approval prompt

allowedCommands.title: Permitted shell commands
allowedCommands.description: Shell commands that run without an approval prompt

blockedCommands.title: Denied shell commands
blockedCommands.description: Shell commands that are denied automatically

codex.description: Sets how Codex treats file edits and command execution

default.title: Default
default.description: Trusted commands such as ls, cat, grep, and git status run automatically; others are skipped. Workspace writes are allowed.

acceptEdits.title: Allow edits
acceptEdits.description: Every command runs automatically inside the workspace sandbox.

bypassPermissions.title: Bypass approval
bypassPermissions.description: Commands run without restrictions, with full disk and network access. Use only when trusted.

technicalInfo.default: workspace-write sandbox with untrusted approval. Trusted commands include cat, cd, grep, head, ls, pwd, tail, Git status/log/diff/show, and find without -exec.
technicalInfo.acceptEdits: workspace-write sandbox with no approvals. Commands run automatically in the project directory.
technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: danger-full-access sandbox with no approvals. Use full system access only in trusted environments.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: Use the chat mode button to override this for one session.
